question: In 2025, Shri Jayant Chaudhary launched _______, a Women Entrepreneurship Programme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swavalambini**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2025**, **Shri Jayant Chaudhary** introduced the **Swavalambini** programme as a specialized initiative to promote **women entrepreneurship** in India.
 
• The **Swavalambini** programme aims to encourage and empower women by providing them with **financial assistance, mentorship, and skill development opportunities** to establish and run their own businesses.
 
• It specifically targets **women from rural and semi-urban areas** who face financial and social barriers in accessing entrepreneurship opportunities.
 
• Through this initiative, women are offered **low-interest loans, subsidies, and access to training programs** in various fields such as handicrafts, agriculture, technology, and small-scale industries.
 
• The Swavalambini programme is a step towards achieving **gender equality** in the workforce and promoting **socio-economic development** through women-led enterprises.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mahila Samridhi Yojana:**

 
 
• Launched in **1993**, this scheme aimed to empower rural women through **microcredit financing**.
 
• It provided financial assistance to women for starting income-generating activities such as dairy farming, tailoring, and handicrafts.
 
• This initiative was specifically targeted at women from **Below Poverty Line (BPL)** families.
 
 
 
• **Udyogini:**
 
 
• A scheme introduced to support **rural women entrepreneurs** by providing them with micro-loans and subsidies.
 
• It focuses on **small-scale business ventures** such as tailoring, cattle rearing, and grocery shops.
 
• The scheme is implemented by various state governments and NGOs.
 
 
 
• **Stree Shakti:**
 
 
• Launched to empower **women in villages** by forming Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
 
• It provides financial assistance and skill training to women for income-generating activities.
 
• The scheme also promotes **financial literacy** among rural women.
 
 
 
• **Swavalambini:**
 
 
• This programme emphasizes **inclusive growth** by targeting women entrepreneurs from marginalized communities.
 
• It combines financial assistance with mentorship, creating a comprehensive ecosystem for women entrepreneurs to thrive.
 
• Special focus is given to skill development in areas such as **technology, agriculture, and renewable energy**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Women Entrepreneurship in India:**

 
 
• India has seen a significant rise in women entrepreneurs, with government schemes playing a pivotal role in this development.
 
• As of **2023**, women account for approximately **20% of the total entrepreneurs** in India.
 
• Key challenges faced by women entrepreneurs include **lack of financial resources, social stigma, and limited access to markets**.
 
• Initiatives like **Swavalambini** aim to address these barriers by creating a supportive ecosystem for women-led enterprises.
